_comment: Deterministic eligibility rules for every scheme in schemes.json, keyed by scheme id.

Edit this file to change a rule; no code change is needed. Rules are taken from each scheme's eligibilityCriteria text in schemes.json - check them against the official scheme guidelines before relying on them.
landHectares     { max }                   holding size, from areaAcres (1 ha = 2.47105 acres)
cropDuration     { allowed:[...] }         crop class from cropProfiles.json: annual | long-duration | perennial
ageRange         { min, max }              farmer age in years
oneOf            { field, allowed:[...] }  a string field must be one of the values
flagFalse        { field }                 an EXCLUSION: true disqualifies, false is fine, missing is unknown
purposeKeywords  { keywords:[...] }        the free-text loan purpose must mention one of the words
positive         { field }                 a number that must be present and > 0

Every rule: id, type, hard, pass, fail, optionally unknown. hard=true means a failure makes the farmer NOT ELIGIBLE; hard=false means a failure only makes it NEEDS MORE INFO (a limit that varies by state/season, or a keyword match that can miss).
A rule whose input is missing is 'unknown', and the answer becomes NEEDS MORE INFO naming what is missing.
Verdict for a scheme: any hard failure -> not_eligible; otherwise any unknown or soft failure -> needs_more_info; otherwise eligible.

fields.landTenure: whether you own, lease or sharecrop your land
fields.governmentEmployee: whether you are or were a government employee above Class IV
fields.institutionalLandholder: whether the land is held by an institution
fields.registeredProfessional: whether you are a registered professional (doctor, engineer, lawyer, CA)
fields.coveredBySocialSecurity: whether you are covered by another statutory social security scheme

pm-kisan.eligibleReason: You own your land and none of the exclusions apply.

rules.pass: The land is in your own name, as PM-KISAN requires.
rules.fail: PM-KISAN is paid only to landowners, and you farm {value} land.

rules.pass: {holding} ({hectares} ha) is within the 2-hectare primary target group.
rules.fail: {hectares} ha is above the 2-hectare primary target group; larger holders are not automatically excluded, so confirm with your local office.

rules.pass: You are not excluded as a government employee.
rules.fail: Serving or retired government employees above Class IV are excluded from PM-KISAN.

rules.pass: You are not excluded as an income-tax payer.
rules.fail: Income-tax payers are excluded from PM-KISAN.

rules.pass: You are not excluded as a registered professional.
rules.fail: Professionals such as doctors, engineers, lawyers and CAs are excluded from PM-KISAN.

rules.pass: The land is not held by an institution.
rules.fail: Institutional landholders are excluded from PM-KISAN.

kcc.eligibleReason: Owner-cultivators, tenant farmers and sharecroppers can get a Kisan Credit Card.

rules.pass: As a {value} farmer you can apply for a Kisan Credit Card.
rules.fail: KCC is for farmers who own or cultivate land, and you have told us you do not.

pmfby.eligibleReason: You farm as an owner or tenant and your crop is an annual crop that is normally covered.

rules.pass: As a {value} farmer you can take crop insurance.
rules.fail: Crop insurance is for farmers who own or cultivate the land, and you have told us you do not.

rules.pass: {crop} ({duration}, {category}) is within the crop types this scheme covers.
rules.fail: {crop} is a {duration} crop, but PMFBY mainly covers {allowed} crops; long-duration and perennial crops are covered only in some states and seasons, so confirm the state notification.
rules.unknown: {crop} is not in our crop reference data, so we cannot confirm it is a notified crop.

aif.eligibleReason: Your loan purpose is post-harvest infrastructure, which this fund finances.

rules.pass: Your loan purpose ("{value}") is post-harvest infrastructure, which AIF funds.
rules.fail: AIF only finances post-harvest infrastructure such as warehouses, cold storage and processing units, and "{value}" does not look like one; confirm your project qualifies.

interest-subvention.eligibleReason: Your loan is a short-term crop loan, which is what the interest subsidy covers.

rules.pass: Your loan purpose ("{value}") is a short-term crop loan, which MISS covers.
rules.fail: MISS reduces interest only on short-term crop loans, and "{value}" does not look like one; confirm with your bank.

soil-health-card.eligibleReason: You hold land, and the scheme has no income or land-size limit.

rules.pass: You have a land record ({acres} acres); every landholding farmer is eligible.
rules.fail: The Soil Health Card is for farmers who hold land, and the land size recorded is not valid.

pm-kisan-maandhan.eligibleReason: You are aged 18-40, hold up to 2 hectares, and are not excluded.

rules.pass: Age {age} is within the 18-40 entry range.
rules.fail: Age {age} is outside the 18-40 range for joining the Maandhan pension.
{hectares} ha is above the 2-hectare limit, which is a hard requirement for the Maandhan pension.

rules.pass: You are not excluded as an income-tax payer.
rules.fail: Income-tax payers cannot join the Maandhan pension.

rules.pass: You are not covered by another statutory social security scheme.
rules.fail: People already covered by another statutory social security scheme cannot join the Maandhan pension.
